thread.title: Apple : Won't Release 5G Phone Until 2020, Sources Say -- Bloomberg | MarketScreener

author: www.4-traders.com
title: Apple : Won't Release 5G Phone Until 2020, Sources Say -- Bloomberg | MarketScreener
text:
--Apple Inc. (AAPL) isn't planning on releasing a 5G compatible phone until 2020, Bloomberg reports Monday, citing "people familiar with its plans."
--Apple expects the new network will encounter technical problems and, as has happened with new releases in the past, buyers will wait before purchasing compatible phones, the report said.
Full story: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-12-03/apple-is-said-to-miss-rapid-5g-takeoff-sitting-out-tech-shift
--Write to Stephen Nakrosis at stephen.nakrosis@wsj.com
